question: Should pre-processing acknowledgment reactions use a deterministic configured pool, random selection, rule-based message classification, or a model-driven contextual choice?
rationale: This introduces public configuration and cross-channel runtime policy; implementation cannot safely choose the latency, determinism, fallback, and unsupported-emoji semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Deterministic pool
options.body: Add a backward-compatible reaction pool with a documented stable selection algorithm and per-channel fallback behavior.

options.title: Rule-based selector
options.body: Select reactions from inexpensive explicit message attributes, requiring a maintained classification contract but no extra model call.

options.title: Model-driven selector
options.body: Run a pre-ack model decision, accepting additional latency, cost, nondeterminism, and failure handling before processing.

recommendation.title: Deterministic pool
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible reaction pool with a documented stable selection algorithm and per-channel fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing discussion records this person making the clearest product-direction assessment for this exact request.
